edits.new:
(legacy AC1, AC2, AC3, AC11).
- The six consumed operations (the rwb-case transfer request, the rwb-case queue and capacity read, the LOV-TRANSFER-REASON read, the rwb-decision package read, the rwb-access authorise call and the rwb-source-data case-facts read) have no published operation name yet (GAP-3076). The clients and their fakes are built from the documented use, and each owner's published name replaces the placeholder in a minor contract version with no change in behaviour.
- The split of the package TRANSFER evaluation between this story and RWB-S8-E1021-APP is for the solution architect to confirm (GAP-3077). The package stays one artefact with one version, read from this service, and the manual and case-trigger paths stay with the primary slice.
- The Kafka event names of the case triggers on rwb.case.events.v1 and rwb.source-data.events.v1 are not published (GAP-3079). The consumer groups are declared against the placeholder, the TransferTrigger is built from the documented event codes EV-05, EV-06, EV-07, EV-09, EV-12, EV-16 and EV-18, and the subscription is faked from Day 1 until the owners publish the names.
- The rule ID, the package version and the from and to queue and owner of a transfer are recorded in the decision record of DP-03 and in no column outside the baseline. The case-side label stays with rwb-case on the transfer call (GAP-3080). A rule_id and rule_version column on the deviation table is added only if an audit read requires it.
- The DP table adds platform contract rows by pattern application, not as build dependencies: H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1072-CON, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, RWB-PLT-TE006-CON, RWB-PLT-E1071-CON, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON, and C RWB-P7-E1073-CON and RWB-P3-E1043-CON (GAP-3075). The build list stays empty and C stays RWB-P3-E1021-CON, and the story builds against the published baselines and fakes.
- The database login of rwb-case is not named in the source documents (GAP-0688). The placeholder 'the rwb-case login (DP-02)' stays until the ACE DB team names it and its grant set, and the chart then takes it by vault secret reference.
